title: Managing and Editing Email Templates
text:
## Managing and Editing Email Templates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000003538
Email templates control the content and structure of system-generated messages sent to members, including notifications, invoices, and account updates. This article explains how to access, edit, and manage these templates within the admin area, along with how customized versions are handled.

## Locating the Email Templates Editor
The following steps outline how to locate and edit any email template.
Login to the Admin area of the site and navigate to Emails - Email Templates.
Locate the email template to edit either by scrolling through the list or by searching for keywords in the email template in the “Filter by Keyword” field:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176414111/original/cnzgaT75U5YcTNnlhTZR4kB-YZuwp7mmcg.png?1774316129 | alt: ]

## Email Template Types
There are 6 categories to select from when sorting by category.

## Newsletter Emails
Newsletter Emails have a varying total of templates. This tab will display any email that was created when sending a newsletter.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445121/original/4TFQiJmQchc5zPb2FZUVRr8jzT8pzvZb2g.png?1774367580 | alt: ]

[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445169/original/Khd4flpclBXXdW0iPEwys_f2hS1HXN_deg.png?1774367649 | alt: ]

## My Saved Templates
My Saved Templates will have a varying total of templates.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445234/original/zzr-ajNcCGL--RzI4ZnAZlKkhIPDkKWSmQ.png?1774367714 | alt: ]
This tab will display any template that has been assigned the " My Saved Templates " category.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181565161/original/80IZ0UMWAayz7BnueLsomgp_CUqlhOirVA.png?1783361915 | alt: ]

## Customizing a Template
Once the template has been identified, click on the “ Customize ” button for the email template:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445387/original/1nFXCVz1QdgYj_pKcX5vtRfyrRAHq_3r0w.png?1774367862 | alt: ]

## Edit Customized Template
To edit a template that has already been copied to the website, go to the “Customized Email Templates” section, find the template, and select “ Edit ” from the Actions dropdown.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445792/original/YzeSQAePQgWlnGdqR7gTvSgBMxksRh6wEA.png?1774368189 | alt: ]

## Preview Template
A modal will pop up when viewing the Preview of the template:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176445848/original/uPK392roviyU-qlLMrYBHACBp9OpKA_7vQ.png?1774368233 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12166103399/original/chxv__ZC3ofL2dY9ll6kJsl9wx23XVHwNw.png?1755625754 | alt: ]
Please note that when cloning an email template to the site, the system automatically adds " copy-of- " to the title of the template. This will happen automatically if the name of the default email template is not changed. This is a way to avoid conflicts with duplicate email templates.

## Disable a Template
To disable an email template, it must first be customized. Once customized, the template will appear in its own tab in the Email Templates area. Similar to widgets and forms, customized email templates can also be disabled. After customization, a Disable option will appear in the Actions dropdown for that template.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176446482/original/M7KKGS4AVN-3EYis3kga4O3keU1TszGeFA.png?1774368658 | alt: ]
Disabling an email template can be helpful when troubleshooting automated emails or testing custom email configurations.
